reason: This plugin is primarily a media tooling extension for DeepSeek Harness, centered on offloading non-text tasks to Gemini-based multimodal capabilities. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows it adds clearly scoped tools for media understanding, transcription, image generation, and document reading, with configurable external provider backends.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多模态能力的插件，可通过 Gemini API 或本地 Antigravity CLI 实现图片、音频、视频和文档的理解与转写，并支持按提示生成图片。
summaries.en: This plugin adds multimodal support to DeepSeek Harness, enabling image, audio, video, and document understanding, media transcription, and prompt-based image generation through Gemini services.

capabilities: media understanding for image, audio, video, and URL inputs
document reading/summarization for PDF, Office, and text files
external API or local CLI provider selection

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness plugin providing multimodal tools: image/audio/video/document understanding, transcription, and image generation.
README lists provider options (Gemini API key or local Antigravity CLI), which implies network-dependent calls to external services and credential/config handling.
README mentions generated images are saved to a local output directory, indicating filesystem output handling.
Package metadata identifies the project as a DSH plugin package and includes dsh-related dependencies, confirming integration into the harness plugin runtime.
